newsitem.title: USA: JAX sees earnings boost on two building projects.
newsitem.headline: JAX sees earnings boost on two building projects.

text.p: JAX International Inc said Friday that development and pre-construction sales are beginning on the first El Paso subdivision of affordable homes the company is building, and that the development should net it between $0.25 and $0.30 a share in 1997.
Construction is expected to begin within 90 to 120 days, said the company.

JAX also said that it has signed a contract to buy 90 lots in Tulsa, Okla., on which it plans to build affordable housing over the next year. The company said the project sould boost gross revenues between $4.5 millon and $5 million, and add $0.35 a share in earnings.

The company added that with over $.50 per share in earnings and only 800,000 shares in its float, it could expect a short-term move in its stock price to between $2 and $3 a share, and between $4 and $5 a share in the next six to 12 months.
